correctivePass.prompt: Edit this illustration into a production-ready SPARSE OPEN CONTOUR overlay for a dark astronomical star field. Keep the same single animal species and elegant Chinese traditional contour pose. The only visible marks must be crisp fine warm ivory / very pale gold ink LINES; each enclosed region must have EMPTY TRANSPARENT INTERIOR, including inside the body, scales, feathers, shell and mane. Remove ALL translucent white/pale washes, solid filled areas, fuzzy halos, shading, surface color, gradients and glow. Do not replace these with any backdrop. Genuine RGBA alpha transparency; completely zero alpha between lines and outside them. Reduce dense internal detail to a few well-placed contour strokes so stars can remain clearly visible through the whole body. Keep the entire subject visible, scale it to fit with at least 8% empty transparent margin on all four sides; do not crop wings, claws, tail or head. imageRegistration.method: Whole-image placement by sky-region centre, main axis and angular scale. Original artwork proportions and contours are preserved; no local warp is applied.

imageRegistration.preservedData: Catalog star positions and source-based asterism lines are not moved by artwork placement.
imageRegistration.interpretation: Modern teaching imagery follows the correct sky region and overall orientation. Local image features need not coincide with individual stars; this is not an exact historical image or stellar anatomy reconstruction.

wolf.positionReference: Sirius region; eye is an artistic source-image landmark.
wolf.orientationAndScale: Artistic parameters; virtual orientation guides are not catalog stars.

imageRegistration.coverage: The 312 catalogue entries are separate from 39 artwork assets: 32 individual asterism illustrations and seven regional overviews. Source-based member charts remain available without a dedicated illustration.
imageRegistration.acceptance: Final rendered composition, whole-image orientation, projection and bounded texture use are checked for the current batch; any local landmark residual is not an exact per-star alignment claim.
